overview.title: Diagnostics
overview.description: Check permissions, runtime tools, network settings, and export a redacted support bundle.
overview.serviceOffline: The background service is unavailable, so service-side checks could not run. Shell checks and support bundle export remain available.
overview.noChecksYet: Run checks to inspect app placement, permissions, toolchain, and network health.

reasons.not_requested: Skipped unless network & clock check is enabled.
reasons.app_translocated: macOS App Translocation is active; move Atd to Applications.
reasons.running_from_dmg_readonly: Running from a read-only disk image volume.
reasons.signature_invalid: Application code signature could not be verified.
reasons.requirement_drifted: Code signing requirement changed since permissions were granted.
reasons.app_running_under_rosetta: Running under Rosetta translation on Apple silicon.
reasons.rosetta_absent_info: Native architecture active; Rosetta 2 not installed.
reasons.custom_feed_url: A custom update feed URL override is active.
reasons.finder_sync_disabled: Finder Sync extension is not enabled.
reasons.not_granted: Permission has not been granted yet.
reasons.stale_or_duplicate_app_grant: Permission may be bound to a duplicate or older copy of Atd.
reasons.granted_pending_relaunch: Permission granted; relaunch Atd for it to take effect.
reasons.post_event_denied: Permission to post synthetic keyboard/mouse events is missing.
reasons.uuremote_tap_install_failed: Remote modifier event tap could not be installed.
reasons.secure_event_input_active: Another app enabled Secure Keyboard Entry, blocking global shortcuts and selection capture.
reasons.launch_approval_key_unreadable: MCP launch approval key cannot be read from Keychain without prompting.
reasons.launch_approval_key_malformed: Stored MCP launch approval key is malformed.
reasons.provider_credential_unreadable: One or more provider credentials could not be read from Keychain.
reasons.service_unavailable_failed: Background agent service failed to start.
reasons.service_stopped_too_often: Background service stopped repeatedly and paused automatic restarts.
reasons.adopted_foreign_bundle_node: Detected a service process launched from a different Atd bundle.
reasons.control_stream_reconnecting: Control stream is reconnecting to the background service.
reasons.corrupt_lock_auto_recovered: A stale or corrupt service lock file was automatically recovered.
reasons.automation_store_corrupt: Automations store reported a structural problem.
reasons.unclean_previous_shutdown: Previous service session did not shut down cleanly.
reasons.disk_critically_low_lt_200mb: Less than 200 MB of free disk space remains.
reasons.disk_low_lt_1gb: Less than 1 GB of free disk space remains.
reasons.ledger_approaching_64mb_cap: Task ledger file size is approaching the 64 MB cap.
reasons.non_local_home_volume: Home directory is not on a local volume.
reasons.host_lock_held_by_other_pid: Computer use host lock is held by another Atd process.
reasons.unsettled_session_pending: An unsettled computer use session is pending cleanup.
reasons.login_shell_timed_out_5s: Login shell PATH lookup timed out after 5 seconds.
reasons.login_shell_exited_without_path: Login shell exited without reporting PATH.
reasons.login_shell_slow_gt_2500ms: Login shell startup took more than 2.5 seconds.
reasons.unsupported_node_version: Bundled Node.js version does not match supported requirements.
reasons.rg_not_found_on_path: ripgrep (rg) was not found on PATH.
reasons.rg_bad_cpu_arch_ebadarch: ripgrep binary architecture is incompatible with this Mac.
reasons.mcp_required_launcher_missing: A launcher required by configured MCP servers (npx/uvx) is missing.
reasons.cli_bad_cpu_arch_ebadarch: A CLI tool binary architecture is incompatible with this Mac.
reasons.optional_cli_not_installed: Some optional CLI tools are not installed.
reasons.pac_or_wpad_fallback_to_direct: PAC or WPAD proxy configuration fell back to direct connections.
reasons.socks_only_fallback_to_direct: SOCKS-only proxy configuration fell back to direct connections.
reasons.authenticated_proxy_unsupported: Authenticated HTTP proxy is not supported by the relay.
reasons.glob_bypass_rules_skipped: Some wildcard proxy bypass rules were skipped.
reasons.child_env_missing_system_proxy: System proxy is active, but child process proxy env vars are not exported.
reasons.system_keychain_ca_not_trusted_by_node: Custom root certificates exist in Keychain without Node system CA trust enabled.
reasons.extra_ca_certs_missing_or_unreadable: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS points to a missing or unreadable file.
reasons.loopback_rtt_high_gt_200ms: Localhost IPC round-trip latency exceeded 200 ms.
reasons.loopback_unreachable: Localhost IPC endpoint could not be reached.
reasons.dev_renderer_unreachable: The Vite renderer dev server (127.0.0.1) could not be reached.
reasons.external_home_unsupported: Home directory on an external volume is not supported for file indexing.
reasons.fsevents_watch_failed: File system event watcher failed to initialize.
reasons.index_store_failed: File index store failed to open.
reasons.sqlite_in_memory_fallback: Memory index fell back to in-memory SQLite storage.
reasons.fts5_trigram_unavailable: SQLite FTS5 trigram tokenizer is unavailable.
reasons.not_installed_optional: Optional browser engine add-on is not installed.
reasons.addons_lock_missing_or_invalid: Add-ons lock manifest is missing or invalid.
reasons.addon_broken_install_dropped: A broken add-on installation was removed.
reasons.mcp_connections_degraded: One or more enabled MCP servers reported connection errors.
reasons.wps_bridge_error: WPS selection bridge reported an error.
reasons.clock_skew_gt_300s: System clock differs from server time by more than 5 minutes.
reasons.clock_skew_gt_120s: System clock differs from server time by more than 2 minutes.
reasons.tls_untrusted_ca_mitm: TLS verification failed; check proxy or custom root certificates.
reasons.network_unreachable: External update mirror could not be reached.
reasons.provider_auth_failed: One or more provider endpoints rejected authentication.
reasons.provider_tls_or_proxy_failed: Provider endpoint connection failed due to TLS or proxy settings.
reasons.local_network_permission_denied: Local network access to a local model endpoint was denied by macOS.
reasons.doctor_budget_exceeded: Diagnostic check timed out before completing.

remediation.move_bundle_to_applications: Move Atd.app into /Applications or ~/Applications and relaunch it from there.
remediation.relaunch_or_reinstall_signed_app: Relaunch Atd or reinstall a signed release build.
remediation.install_native_arm64_build: Install the native Apple silicon build for optimal performance.
remediation.enable_login_items_extensions: Open System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions to verify Atd extensions.
remediation.grant_or_reset_accessibility: Allow Atd in Accessibility settings, and remove duplicate copies of Atd.app if listed.
remediation.grant_screen_recording: Allow Atd in Screen & System Audio Recording settings, then relaunch.
remediation.grant_input_monitoring: Allow Atd in Input Monitoring settings.
remediation.close_secure_input_holder: Exit password fields or disable Terminal Secure Keyboard Entry, then verify with the Selection live probe.
remediation.reapprove_mcp_or_reconnect_provider: Re-approve affected MCP servers in Extensions or reconnect providers in Models.
remediation.inspect_service_recovery: Restart the service or export a support bundle if recovery warnings persist.
remediation.free_disk_or_fix_permissions: Ensure at least 1 GB of free space and write access to the Atd data directory.
remediation.reconcile_computer_host: Quit any other running copy of Atd and relaunch.
remediation.optimize_shell_rc_profile: Check your shell startup files (~/.zshrc) for slow commands that delay PATH resolution.
remediation.install_native_ripgrep: Install a native ripgrep (rg) binary or verify your PATH.
remediation.fix_mcp_cli_toolchain: Verify npx/uvx availability and review MCP server configuration in Extensions.
remediation.configure_supported_http_proxy: Use a standard HTTP/HTTPS proxy configuration if needed.
remediation.configure_proxy_and_ca_trust: Check proxy environment variables and custom CA certificate configuration.
remediation.check_loopback_firewall_vpn: Check firewall, VPN, or endpoint security rules affecting 127.0.0.1 loopback traffic.
remediation.start_pnpm_dev_renderer: Ensure pnpm dev is running in your terminal so the Vite dev server is listening.
remediation.reinstall_or_check_home_volume: Verify Atd installation and ensure your home folder is on a local volume.
remediation.inspect_memory_index_fallback: Check disk permissions or export a support bundle to inspect memory index logs.
remediation.manage_browser_addon: Manage or reinstall the browser add-on in Computer use settings.
remediation.open_mcp_extensions_settings: Review MCP server status and re-connect degraded servers in Extensions.
remediation.sync_clock_or_trust_ca: Enable automatic date & time sync and verify trusted root certificates.
remediation.check_provider_or_local_network: Verify provider credentials in Models and macOS Local Network permission if using a local model.

liveProbes.idle: Ready. Start a probe and trigger the action within 10 seconds.

selection.title: Selection toolbar
selection.description: Select text in another app to trace gesture, activation, and Accessibility gating.

hotkey.title: Shortcuts & modifier handoff
hotkey.description: Press a registered shortcut or double-tap a modifier key without capturing typed characters.

capture.title: Screen capture & display arbiter
capture.description: Inspect display topology, screen freeze readiness, and DeviceArbiter claim state.

preview.title: Export redacted support bundle
preview.description: Personal paths, API keys, tokens, and conversation content are excluded or scrubbed before saving.
preview.includeCrashes: Include recent crash summaries (process & symbol offsets only)
preview.noExcerpt: No text preview available for this entry.
preview.truncatedNote: Preview excerpt truncated; the saved archive contains the full bounded file.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong in this window
errorBoundary.description: The renderer encountered an unexpected error. You can retry rendering or export a redacted support bundle.
